d:
Jharkhand men post maitrik chhatravritti ka bhugtan nahin hone se hajaron vidyarthiyon ki parhaee aur aarthik sthiti prabhavit ho rahi hai. anusuchit jati, anusuchit janjati aur pichhra varg ke vidyarthiyon ko milne vali ee-kalyan chhatravritti ke 3 shaikshanik satron ki rashi ab tak lanbit hai. satr 2024-25 aur 2025-26 ke vidyarthiyon ko bare paimane par bhugtan ka intjar hai.
